test_title: PYST 27: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 17 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A boat takes 76 minutes to go 32.2 km upstream. The ratio of the speed of the boat in still water to that of the stream is 9 : 8. How much approximate total time (in hours) will the boat take to go 44.9 km upstream and 57.8 km downstream?
solution:
**Given:**

Initial upstream distance = 32.2 km

Initial upstream time = 76 minutes

Ratio of speed of boat (B) to speed of stream (S) = 9 : 8

**Formula Used:**

Speed = dfrac{{Distance}}{{Time}}

Upstream Speed = B - S

Downstream Speed = B + S

**Calculations:**

Initial upstream time in hours = dfrac{76}{60} hours

⇒ Initial upstream speed = dfrac{32.2}{(76)/(60)} = dfrac{32.2 times 60}{76} = 25.42 km/hr

Let the speed of boat (B) be 9x and speed of stream (S) be 8x.

⇒ Upstream Speed = B - S = 9x - 8x = x

So, x = 25.42 km/hr

⇒ Downstream Speed = B + S = 9x + 8x = 17x

⇒ Downstream Speed = 17 × 25.42 = 432.14 km/hr

Time for final upstream journey = dfrac{{Final upstream distance}}{{Upstream Speed}} = dfrac{44.9}{25.42}

⇒ Time for final upstream journey ≈ 1.77 hours

Time for final downstream journey = dfrac{{Final downstream distance}}{{Downstream Speed}} = dfrac{57.8}{432.14}

⇒ Time for final downstream journey ≈ 0.13 hours

Total time = Time upstream + Time downstream

⇒ Total time = 1.77 + 0.13 = 1.90 hours

**∴ The total approximate time is 1.90 hours.**
